questions.stem: What principle allows light to travel through an optical fibre?
questions.explanation: Total internal reflection is the principle that allows light to be guided through an optical fibre. It occurs when light reflects entirely within the fibre, preventing it from escaping.

distractorRationale.a: Refraction involves bending of light, not guiding it within a fibre.
distractorRationale.b: Diffraction refers to the bending of light around obstacles, not within a fibre.
distractorRationale.d: Dispersion involves spreading of light into component colours, not guiding it.
